text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 2, "unit": "people/hour", "kind": "count", "span": "help 2 people per hour"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 3, "unit": "hours", "kind": "count", "span": "for 3 hours a day"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 20, "unit": "%", "kind": "count", "span": "he takes 20% of the days ... off"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 19, "unit": "days", "kind": "count", "span": "April 19th"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 31, "unit": "days", "kind": "count", "span": "there are 31 days in March"}, {"id": "q6", "value": 1, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "March 1st"}], "plan": [{"op": "add", "args": ["q5", "q4"], "out": "s1", "note": "total days March 1 - April 19 = 31 + 19 = 50"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s2", "note": "people helped per working day = 2 * 3 = 6"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s1", "q3"], "out": "s3", "note": "days off = 20% of 50 = 10"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s1", "s3"], "out": "s4", "note": "days worked = 50 - 10 = 40"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s4", "s2"], "out": "s5", "note": "total people helped = 40 * 6 = 240"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "total number of people Billy helps with taxes between March 1 and April 19"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 1, "reason": "'March 1st' just marks the start date; the day span is already captured by the 31 and 19 quantities"}]}
